**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record PrinterInfo
```

Describes a printer known to a print system.

## Constructors

```csharp
public PrinterInfo()
```

## Properties

### Description

```csharp
public string? Description { get; init; }
```

Gets the printer's description, if the print system provides one.

### Id

```csharp
public required string Id { get; init; }
```

Gets the identifier used to look up the printer. Unique within the printer catalog.

Treat it as opaque: store it and pass it to [IPrinterCatalog.GetPrinterAsync](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/#getprinterasync) later, even after a restart, but don't parse it. It stays the same for as long as the printer keeps its name in its print system. A network printer found by discovery is identified by its announced name, so renaming it changes its identifier; configure it by URI where an identifier must never change.

```csharp

```

Gets a value indicating whether this is the default printer of its print system.
